newsitem.title: UK: UK Lib Dems blast Conservatives's budget.
newsitem.headline: UK Lib Dems blast Conservatives's budget.

text.p: Tuesday's budget adds up to a net increase in taxes in 1997 of more than one billion pounds, costing the average taxpayer 41 pounds a year, Malcolm Bruce, the economics spokesman of the minority Liberal Democrats, said.

"This budget fools no one. It is a triple Tory con trick, a budget of smoke and mirrors,which does not deliver the lower taxes, lower borrowing and higher spending claimed by the Chancellor," Bruce said in a statement.
He said the budget would impose a 700 million pound rise in council taxes and did little to tackle excessive debt and lock in low inflation.
